document.title: Statement of Work
document.place_of_performance: Remote delivery from AIS facilities with virtual client and Microsoft stakeholder sessions.

background: Adventure Works Transit Alliance is evaluating a governed cloud adoption path for shared transit services.
objectives: Align stakeholders on priority adoption scenarios.
Produce an actionable adoption roadmap and decision register.

in_scope.title: Readiness workshops
in_scope.description: Facilitate stakeholder sessions covering business priorities, governance, and technical readiness.

in_scope.title: Adoption roadmap
in_scope.description: Synthesize workshop decisions into a sequenced roadmap.

out_of_scope.title: Production deployment
out_of_scope.description: Implementation or migration of production workloads is excluded.

deliverables.title: Readiness findings
deliverables.description: Documented findings, constraints, and decisions from the workshops.
acceptance_criteria: Client confirms the findings reflect the workshop record.

deliverables.title: Cloud adoption roadmap
deliverables.description: Sequenced roadmap with owners, dependencies, and decision points.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap addresses the agreed priority scenarios and governance actions.

milestones.title: Workshops complete
milestones.description: Planned stakeholder workshops and findings review are complete.

milestones.title: Roadmap accepted
milestones.description: Roadmap and decision register are submitted for review.

ais.title: Workshop delivery
ais.description: AIS will facilitate sessions and prepare the findings and roadmap deliverables.

client.title: Stakeholder participation
client.description: Client will coordinate stakeholders, provide existing materials, and consolidate feedback.

assumptions.title: Program coordination
assumptions.description: Client and Microsoft program stakeholders will participate in scheduled reviews as needed.

notes: ECIF commercial fields, milestone amounts, and associated values require external commercial review.
